answer: Give every identity terraced water rights at an oasis: a newcomer locks 60 POA for 45 days, starts on the lowest terrace at 10 daily actions, climbing one terrace weekly to a 160 cap. Each epoch, 5% are drafted as jurors sending one surprise task due in 45 minutes; two misses in 30 days burn half the stake and demote it. Slashed stakes reward catching jurors. A zephyr of 1,000 fakes needs 60,000 POA and 1,000 keys at $40 each, yet stays capped at 10 a day. Like a spring watering only travelers who camped beside it, influence is earned by staying, not arriving.
